title: Service an idle queued lifecycle job
invariant: The queue service branch is entered for a pending lifecycle job even when the watcher batch is empty and no retry is due.
scope: Archived source replay of the exact QueuedJobs._watch_queue AST, differing only in the service guard. Lean checks the Boolean guard for an empty batch and no retry; it does not prove scheduling, locking, Python semantics, or completion of the job. Other function shapes are unresolved.
